note: D9 starting spec for pour tea, written in tokens to mirror manip_sim/pour_stages.py: the carry holds teapot.up_axis to world.z (tight) with translation free (the path holds from the lifted entry, so no band there); the carry goal puts the spout tip centered (moderate) over the opening at clearance large / slack snug, the same band as the pour path, so the hand-off lies inside the pour's path; the pour tips teapot.front_axis to mug.-up (tight), a sweep about the teapot's lateral axis, with the spout tip held over the opening

emissions.name: grasp the teapot by its handle
emissions.verify: The gripper is closed on the handle with the grasp point at teapot.handle_center; the teapot is still upright at its spawn pose.
emissions.goal: The gripper closes on the teapot's handle at teapot.handle_center, with the teapot still upright at its spawn pose.

emissions.name: carry the teapot upright over the mug
emissions.verify: Along the carry teapot.+up stays vertical (no spill) with translation free; at the goal teapot.spout_tip is centered over mug.opening_center and sits at least ~8 cm above it, so the pot body and base clear the mug rim and table, and the upright, centered, elevated pose is a valid entry for the pour tilt.
emissions.goal: teapot.spout_tip ends up centered over mug.opening_center and well above it (a clear standoff over the rim, so the pot body and base clear the mug and table), with teapot.+up still pointing the way world.z points.

emissions.name: pour
emissions.verify: Through the whole stage teapot.+left stays level (the tilt hinge) and teapot.spout_tip stays laterally over mug.opening_center while the teapot descends; at the end teapot.+front points the way mug.-up points and the spout tip sits at the mug mouth, within a few cm above mug.opening_center.
emissions.goal: The teapot descends from its standoff and tips forward about its level lateral axis until teapot.+front (the spout direction) points the way mug.-up points, with teapot.spout_tip just above mug.opening_center so the tea falls into the mug.
